Google sign-in fails in production with a 401. Can you take a look?
Found it: the **refresh token** was saved without its expiry date, so `AuthService.refresh()` never renewed it.\n\nI changed `TokenStore.save()` to store `expiresAt` and added automatic renewal.
Great. Now add a test for the expired token case
Done. I added `refreshesExpiredToken()` to `AuthServiceTest` and all *42 tests* pass.
Write a draft of the October newsletter with the course news

Here’s the draft. I kept the tone of the previous ones and highlighted:

- The new **agents** module
- The date of the next cohort
- A link to [the website](https://example.com)
Make it shorter and drop the paragraph about tools
Done: it’s now 180 words and the tools paragraph is gone.
What risks do you see in the migration?

The main risks are:

1. Queries that rely on implicit ordering.
2. The `pg_trgm` extension, which needs updating.
3. Lock time while reindexing.
Build the settings screen. Use Material 3 and respect dark mode
I created `SettingsScreen` with sections for the account, notifications and theme. Colors come from `MaterialTheme.colorScheme`, so dark mode just works.
Write a script that renames the invoice PDFs, using the invoice date in the name
I created `rename-invoices.sh`. It reads the date from each PDF and renames it like `2026-10-01 Supplier.pdf`.
